collection.limits: Public CDX and raw id_ replay only. Optional Korean URL variants and same-resource nearest-capture replay redirects are explicitly recorded; verified means payload digest equals the requested CDX, not that redirected HTTP metadata belongs to its timestamp. Not a WARC export; missing/private/live resources are not reconstructed. Unverified responses remain separate, never called recovered originals.
